meta.title: Peer NPL benchmark (reported) + AutoX measured anchor
meta.note: Listed title-loan peers' reported NPL ratios (their own FY2025 / 2025 IR figures; Heng's is its H1-2026 SET-filed TFRS9 Stage-3 credit-impaired share — the loan-quality metric a hire-purchase/leasing lender publishes in place of a bank-style 90+ NPL, and the closest basis-match to AutoX's own impaired-share read) shown next to AutoX/Ngern Chaiyo's OWN book quality, MEASURED from the real loan tape. NOT a like-for-like league table — peers report on their own bases and write off / provision out deep-delinquent stock that AutoX carries SEPARATELY as 180+ legacy workout inventory — so AutoX is a distinct MEASURED anchor, not ranked inside the reported-peer list. Heng is the one CONTRACTING peer and the only reported peer whose figure brackets AutoX's own impaired share ('compliant' is not 'thriving'). The spread tracks collateral mix: gold/vehicle books run lower NPL, land/agri/heavy-vehicle books higher.
meta.measured: peers = reported by the companies; AutoX = measured from the real loan tape

peers.name: Heng Leasing & Capital
peers.source: Heng SET filing, H1-2026 — Stage 3 credit-impaired 6.78% of gross book (฿542.8m/฿8,002.8m), 30 Jun 2026; TFRS9/IFRS-9 basis (loan-quality analog)

autox.name: AutoX / Ngern Chaiyo
autox.basis: MEASURED — real loan tape (382,735 no-PII accounts), OS-weighted
autox.collateral: motorcycle / pickup / car title + land (mixed, heavier tail)
autox.caveat: NOT a like-for-like rank vs the reported peers: the headline 90-179dpd NPL-live is a share of the LIVE book, while a strict BoT 90+ (incl. the ฿3.05bn 180+ legacy workout stock the tape holds SEPARATELY as late-stage collections inventory) on the full book is higher — and listed peers write off / provision out that deep-delinquent stock, so their reported NPL sits on a different basis. Read the direction, not a precise league position.
